Overhauls weapon progression.
The "LESS" is less research: Progression: Arsenal adds up to 346 research projects depending on your mods. This fork groups them into at most 125, such as Swords, Revolvers, Gun turrets and Charge pistols. Everything stays in the same era, and still needs the other research it did before.
Forked from Progression: Arsenal by ferny. Huge thanks to ferny for the original mod and all the Progression work this builds on. Replaces the original; do not use both.
For a really good modpack, check out The Progression Modpack on the Steam Workshop. ' ' * $args[0].Groups[1].Value.Length ' ' * $args[0].Groups[1].Value.Length
